title: Learning Transferable Skills using Goal-Conditioned Bisimulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.00676v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unsupervised skill discovery has emerged as a promising approach for leveraging reward-free datasets to pretrain general-purpose policies. However, current skill discovery methods either require access to expert data or exhibit limited generalization, failing to transfer effectively to previously unseen layouts. A key challenge is to learn representations that capture the temporal structure of the environment while remaining robust to variations across layouts. To address this issue, we present an objective for learning action-aware temporal representations that satisfy the functional equivariance property while preserving the local temporal structure of the environment. Building upon this embedding, we further propose unsupervised skill discovery using bisimulation, which learns transferable skills by conditioning the behavior of skills exclusively on the subset of state features that directly affect their execution. translated_title: 使用目标条件互模拟学习可迁移技能
translated_abstract: 无监督技能发现已成为一种利用无奖励数据集来预训练通用策略的有前景的方法。然而，现有的技能发现方法要么需要访问专家数据，要么泛化能力有限，无法有效迁移到之前未见过的布局。一个关键挑战是学习既能捕捉环境时间结构、又能对不同布局间的变化保持鲁棒的表征。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一个用于学习动作感知的时间表征的目标函数，该表征在满足函数等变性属性的同时保留环境的局部时间结构。在此嵌入的基础上，我们进一步提出了基于互模拟的无监督技能发现方法，该方法通过仅将技能行为条件化于直接影响其执行的状态特征子集来学习可迁移技能。这强制了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出基于互模拟的无监督技能发现方法，通过学习满足函数等变性的动作感知时间表征，并将技能行为仅条件化于直接影响其执行的状态特征，从而实现技能向未见布局的有效迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an unsupervised skill discovery method based on bisimulation, which learns action-aware temporal representations satisfying functional equivariance and conditions skill behavior only on the state features that directly affect execution, enabling effective transfer of skills to previously unseen layouts.
